excluded_options: First-light uncalibrated March 2025 images were not selected as a calibrated-science exemplar.
Generative artwork, invented starfields, NASA/JPL logos and arbitrary stock-space images were not acquired.
acquisition_notes: Python urllib initially rejected the workstation trust-chain certificate. Files were then retrieved with the Windows curl certificate-verifying HTTPS client; no TLS verification bypass was used.

The JPL page and JPL usage policy were verified through the web tool but direct curl requests returned HTTP 403. The all-sky image itself was successfully downloaded from the exact JPL download link; its alternate official Caltech source-page HTML is retained.
